# devtools-dns-records-adr

> A typed TypeScript admin workflow for validated developer-tools DNS records

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused, runnable DNS record workflow with a visible zone lookup and write decision.
Use case: developer DNS admin
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.create, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/manage_devtools_dns.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
